meta.name: game-ci-pipeline
meta.description: Invoke to set up CI/CD pipelines for game builds -- automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment to Steam, itch.io, or Epic. Triggers on: "CI", "CD", "pipeline", "automated build", "deploy", "Steam deploy", "itch.io butler", "GitHub Actions game", "build automation". Do NOT invoke for general code review (use game-code-review) or manual testing guidance (use game-qa-lead). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为游戏项目搭建CI/CD流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发游戏并需要自动化构建和部署流程
copy.tagline_en: Set up CI/CD pipelines for game builds automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop games and need automated build and deployment pipelines

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成游戏 CI/CD 架构师，能自动生成游戏项目的构建、测试和部署流水线配置（如 GitHub Actions YAML），支持 Godot、Unity 等引擎，并部署到 Steam、itch.io 等平台。
howto.when: 当你提到“CI”、“CD”、“流水线”、“自动构建”、“部署”、“Steam 部署”、“itch.io butler”、“GitHub Actions 游戏”或“构建自动化”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 为我的 Unity 项目设置 CI，包括测试和多平台构建。
say.note: Claude 会提供 GameCI 的配置步骤和代码。

say.text: 如何自动化将游戏部署到 Steam 的 beta 分支？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a game CI/CD architect, automatically generating build, test, and deployment pipeline configurations (e.g., GitHub Actions YAML) for game projects, supporting engines like Godot and Unity, and deploying to platforms such as Steam and itch.io.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "CI", "CD", "pipeline", "automated build", "deploy", "Steam deploy", "itch.io butler", "GitHub Actions game", or "build automation".

say_en.text: Set up GitHub Actions auto-build and deploy to itch.io for my Godot game.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a complete YAML pipeline file.

say_en.text: Configure CI for my Unity project with tests and multi-platform builds.
say_en.note: Claude will provide GameCI configuration steps and code.

say_en.text: How to automate game deployment to Steam beta branch?
say_en.note: Claude will give steamcmd or GameCI deployment config.
